about: The spending categories and what each means. The local model puts each merchant name into one of them (once per merchant: the answer is remembered); the person's own corrections come first. No merchant or word lists: a new merchant needs no edit here.

categories.name: groceries
categories.about: food and household shopping at supermarkets, grocers, markets and delivery of groceries

categories.name: food
categories.about: eating and drinking out or ordered in: restaurants, cafes, takeaway, food delivery

categories.name: transport
categories.about: getting around: public transport, taxis and ride apps, trains, parking, tolls

categories.name: fuel
categories.about: petrol, diesel or charging for a vehicle

categories.name: shopping
categories.about: things bought for yourself or the home that are not food: clothes, electronics, furniture, online shops

categories.name: utilities
categories.about: electricity, gas, water, internet, phone and TV bills

categories.name: rent
categories.about: rent paid for a home or office

categories.name: emi
categories.about: loan and instalment repayments

categories.name: insurance
categories.about: insurance premiums of any kind

categories.name: medical
categories.about: doctors, hospitals, pharmacies, tests, dental and other health costs

categories.name: education
categories.about: school, college, courses, tuition, books for study

categories.name: travel
categories.about: flights, hotels, holiday bookings and other trip costs

categories.name: entertainment
categories.about: cinema, games, events, hobbies and leisure

categories.name: subscriptions
categories.about: recurring digital or media subscriptions and memberships

categories.name: cash
categories.about: cash withdrawals

categories.name: investments
categories.about: money put into investments, funds, shares or pensions

categories.name: transfers
categories.about: money moved between the person's own accounts

categories.name: fees
categories.about: bank charges, taxes, penalties and service fees

categories.name: salary
categories.about: pay from an employer

categories.name: bonus
categories.about: a bonus, 13th month or other extra pay from an employer

categories.name: interest
categories.about: interest earned on savings or deposits

categories.name: refund
categories.about: money returned for something bought, a reversal or cashback

categories.name: income
categories.about: other money received that is none of the above

categories.name: other
categories.about: anything that does not clearly belong to another category
